svg.aria-label: An example day on five Thors, hour by hour. Volt on thor-1 and Ember on thor-2 serve the chat all day. On thor-3, Mira fine-tunes a model for poetry from 07:00 to 13:00, and Kofi curates a set of family recipes from 14:00 to 20:00. thor-4 runs the nightly QLoRA job from midnight to 07:00 and again from 22:00, and Ms. Rao holds a class of six from 09:00 to 16:00. thor-5 runs an evaluation batch from 08:00 to 12:00, and Yuki draws a comic strip on the canvas from 13:00 to 20:00. Each of the four people is shown as a small portrait in their slot. The rest of each row is free.
svg.text: Time slices: who has which Thor, and when
A reservation names a Thor and a window. The rows are Thors, the columns are hours.
An example day. A slice is one whole Thor for a window of time, so two people never share a Thor's memory.
